Michelin Level Indeed
Apr 2025 • Couples
My spouse and I had the pleasure of dining around the world, and Quince/Madam Kew belongs in the top tier.

We walked in without a reservation to a full main dining room, but the staff had some room upstairs. Initially, we thought this would be “less than”, but the decor was that of an upscale, modern lounge with a great vibe.

Then came the menu… a Tomahawk in Ho Chi Minh City… YES!!!! We started with oysters which were presented and served uniquely and beautifully, and then dug into our Tommy with sides of some of the best “Not so Mashed Potatoes” and roasted cauliflower with whipped cheese.

You could tell there was a French influence throughout the service, and we were thrilled to see it.

The flavour, presentation, and service were excellent throughout the night. We enjoyed every bite. Probably too many bites, ha.

I suppose the Michelin Guide was right to feature this restaurant, but maybe they will get a star before too long.
